project.name: Nguyen house, 27 Corella Rise
project.summary: The base Nguyen house, but the design complies with the Housing Code, so it is approved by a complying development certificate from a registered certifier instead of a DA. Everything else is unchanged.

documents.title: Owner's brief: new house at 27 Corella Rise
documents.title_block: label lines before the first ##: Title, Date, Client, Site; one # heading identical to Title

carries.says: A new two-storey detached family house
A new two-storey detached family house
New build on a vacant lot
Complying development certificate under the Housing Code
Architect-led traditional lump-sum tender to three or four residential builders
We want a high-quality, architect-designed home with durable, high-end finishes
The lot is vacant and clear
We are the sole owners and the only decision makers
Two storeys
Site area about 650 m2
Target gross floor area about 300 m2
4 bedrooms
3 bathrooms plus a powder room
Double garage (2 spaces) under the main roof
Site: 27 Corella Rise, Denistone NSW 2114
All-electric home: induction cooktop and heat-pump hot water
HIA NSW Lump Sum Contract with the builder
Construction budget: $1,450,000 excluding GST
Client: Dan and Mai Nguyen
Site: 27 Corella Rise, Denistone NSW 2114
No basement; slab on ground at natural level
No sustainability rating target beyond BASIX
Built in a single stage
One dwelling only; no secondary dwelling
We do not need any Connecting with Country input for this lot

documents.content: The owners' brief to the architect. Sections: About us, The site, The house (rooms, garage, two storeys), Quality and budget, How we want to build (architect-led design, a complying development certificate under the Housing Code, select tender, HIA lump sum), Services (all-electric, rainwater tank, ducted air-conditioning). Written in plain first-person prose by the owners.

documents.filename: Detail and boundary survey report - 27 Corella Rise.md
documents.title: Detail and boundary survey report
documents.title_block: label lines: Title, Ref: CM-26-0412, Date: 24 February 2026, Prepared by

carries.says: Site area by survey: 650.2 m2
No structures on site; the lot is vacant
No Sydney Water assets are within the property
The lot drains to the Sydney Water sewer main in the street; junction shown at the front boundary
Water main in Corella Rise; Sydney Water connection available

traps.what: Says 'connect to the sewer main in the street', which matches the authority_asset trigger (DOMAIN.md §10 trap 8).
traps.expect: flag.authority_asset stays no: the main is in the street, not in the lot, and the report says no Sydney Water assets are within the property

traps.what: Lists a large blue gum near the rear boundary and a jacaranda on No. 25 next to the northern boundary.
traps.expect: d03 alone does not set either arborist flag: presence is not an impact

documents.content: Surveyor's report accompanying the detail and contour survey on AHD: control, boundary identification against the DP, easements (none), levels (gentle 0.9 m fall from street to rear: generally level), trees over 5 m with spreads, street features, services from Dial Before You Dig and Sydney Water records.

documents.title: Geotechnical investigation report
documents.title_block: label lines: Title, Report no: RG-26-0388, Revision: 0, Report date: 21 April 2026

carries.says: Site classification: Class M in accordance with AS 2870
No groundwater was encountered in the boreholes to 3.0 m
No excavation is proposed within the zone of influence of neighbouring footings
No basement is proposed; the house is a slab on ground

traps.what: Recommends: 'excavate to a depth of 300 mm to remove topsoil under the slab platform', which matches the basement trigger (DOMAIN.md §10 trap 9).
Mentions 'H2 treated pine' for termite protection of framing next to the site classification.
traps.expect: det.site_class is M; H2 is a timber hazard class, not a site class (DOMAIN.md §10 trap 4)

documents.content: Geotechnical report: fieldwork (three boreholes, DCP tests), subsurface profile (topsoil over stiff silty clay over shale), laboratory shrink-swell results, AS 2870 site classification Class M, footing and slab recommendations, earthworks and site drainage advice.

The trees section must use the sentence 'No neighbouring or street trees are affected by the works.'
